name: Mortal Kombat II — Arcade Story
notes: Primary arcade intro/story text preserved by Mortal Kombat Warehouse. It states that Shang Tsung's scheme ended at Liu Kang's hands; that, facing execution for his failure and Goro's apparent death, Tsung convinced Shao Kahn to grant him a second chance; and that Tsung's new plan was to lure his enemies to compete in Outworld, where Shao Kahn intended to destroy them.
